reviews.text: Great experience looking after my English Bulldog! Thank you so much for taking such good care of him!

We were looking for a dog sitter for our 3-month-old puppy, and what can we say… Kal-El is very happy to go (at least once a week).

They go for long walks and to the dog park in all kinds of weather.
When he's there, we have 100% confidence in Jonathan. He's very accommodating, very professional, and wonderful with dogs. You can trust him completely; he truly loves his job!

Jonathan is an exceptional dog sitter. His organized approach and varied, well-planned walks, both morning and afternoon, demonstrate his dedication and professionalism. He handled challenging situations with reassuring ease, allowing us to go about our business without worry. Our dog is always eager to go back to him.

Having had disappointing experiences with other professionals, I am grateful to have found Jonathan. His love for his work and for our animals is evident, and he manages to maintain a high level of professionalism while establishing clear rules that ensure a safe environment for our companions.

His thoughtful gesture of giving our dog a Christmas gift was greatly appreciated, showing his commitment and affection for our animals. We have complete confidence in him and are truly happy to have met him. Without a doubt, Jonathan is much more than a dog sitter; he is a true partner in the well-being of our pets.

We've had Jonathan look after our dog Stella several times now. We're extremely satisfied with the services provided. The dogs get long walks during the day, go to the park, and it's a real pleasure to see Stella having fun with the other dogs in the videos on his Instagram account. I highly recommend him!
